headline: Cybersecurity · Risk analytics · Software engineering
intro_headline: Data Analyst Intern @ Delhivery | Former SOC Intern @ RailTel | M.Tech Student | Developer of Maskr
intro: I work at the intersection of cybersecurity, operational risk, and software engineering. From SOC detection and logistics analytics to on-device privacy tools, I build systems that make complex work clearer and safer.

highlights: Develop risk and fraud detection models for logistics data, focusing on high-risk shipment anomalies and loss prevention.
Turn shipment tracking and telematics data into operational insights and process controls.
Worked with Elastic SIEM across 500K+ daily security events; tuned EQL/KQL detection rules to reduce false positives by 15%.
Automated threat intelligence enrichment and supported incident response, SOC procedures, and MITRE ATT&CK-mapped reporting.

projects.name: Maskr
projects.description: An on-device privacy guard that checks prompts and attachments for sensitive data before they reach AI chatbots. Published on the Chrome Web Store.
projects.detail: Combines local detection, masking, and image redaction for ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and Copilot.
projects.stack: JavaScript · Manifest V3 · ONNX Runtime Web · On-device inference
projects.visual_detail: Local detection, masking, and attachment redaction.
